decisionsTitle: A picture is replaced in place, everywhere a picture is kept (amending §72, §73)
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-10-08:** «Queued feature: I should be able to replace a picture via a button».

**What existed.** Two places that keep a picture already replaced it in place: a card of «Echipa» (`TeamPhotoField`, §541) and the bib designer's two pictures (`BibPictureField`, §560), both through the one shared `uploadPicture`. Two places did not: a photo of an album could only be deleted («Șterge») and uploaded again — which put it last in the album and moved the cover to the first remaining photo — and a picture in a rich text could only be removed and inserted again, losing its description, caption, width and placement.

**Decision.** One behaviour and one word, «Înlocuiește» / «Replace», everywhere a picture is kept.

- *One service verb*, `replaceStoredPicture` in `media/service.ts`, for every place that keeps a picture by its id: the new picture's objects are stored first, under a **new key prefix**; then one transaction writes the new `media_assets` row, lets the caller move its own references to it (`repoint`), deletes the old row only when the one references predicate (`media/references.ts`, §73) says nothing else uses it — another album, a text, a card of «Echipa», a bib design, a draft — and writes one audit row `media.picture_replaced` `{ from, to, where, oldDeleted }`; after the commit the caller's public cache tags are expired, and last the old objects are deleted, best effort, as a photo's delete does. A transaction that fails removes the new objects again, so no row ever names a picture that is half there.
- *Why a new prefix.* Every public address embeds the prefix, and the browser, the CDN and the rendered pages hold the old bytes under the old address for up to a day (§549). New bytes under the old prefix would show the old picture to whoever cached it and the new one to nobody; a new prefix is an address no cache has seen.
- *The gallery.* Each photo of an album has «Înlocuiește» beside «Șterge» (44 px, the swap glyph `replace`): the uploader's own file input for one file, shrunk in the browser at the quality remembered from «Calitate» above (§414, §437), with the same limits and the same refusal words as an upload. The new picture takes the same `gallery_items` row, so its order number (`position`) and its place on the public album do not move, and when it was the album's cover the cover moves with it; the album's `updated_at` (the sitemap's date) moves. The gallery's public cache is expired, one audit row is written. The authorization is the delete's (`isEditorial`, BR-REQ-060-01), asserted in `replacePhoto` before anything is encoded and in the route. It goes through the album's upload route (`POST /api/admin/gallery/{id}/photos` with `replaceItemId`) rather than a Server Action beside `deletePhotoAction`: an action's body stops at 1 MB and the browser sends up to 4 MB (`BROWSER_SEND_BYTES`), which is why every photo already arrives through that route.
- *The text.* In a selected picture's panel, beside the crop box, «Înlocuiește» uploads through `uploadPicture` exactly as inserting a picture does (the remembered quality, the facts and the refusal under the toolbar), then changes the **same** image node (`replacedPictureAttrs`): the new address and stored size; `alt`, `caption`, the width share and the placement kept; the crop and the card's centre cleared, because they are fractions of the old photograph (§241, §454) and mean nothing on another. Nothing else in the document moves. The node is found again after the upload by its position and its address (`findPictureToReplace`), so text typed meanwhile does not misplace it.
- *Why the text's old picture waits.* At upload time the document is not saved and the organizer may still cancel; deleting the old picture then would break the saved page. Once a save no longer names it, the orphan sweep takes it after its week (§73), as it takes a picture removed from a text. The same picture in the other language's document (the English copy «Copiază și tradu tot» made) is that document's own reference and is not touched: the help line says «În fiecare limbă separat».
- *One word.* The team card's «Schimbă fotografia» and the bib's «Încarcă alta» now read «Înlocuiește» / «Replace» too — labels only, the behaviour is unchanged.

No migration (the same tables), no dependency; the editor's client code grows by one verb.

**Refused.** Overwriting the objects under the old prefix: the caches would keep the old picture, and a failed upload would leave a half-replaced one. Deleting the text's old picture at upload time: the text is not saved yet. A Server Action for the gallery's replace: its 1 MB body is below what the browser sends.

Amends §72 (a picture in the text is replaced, not only removed) and §73 (a replaced picture leaves through the same reference check and sweep).

Tests: integration `cms/picture-replace.test.ts` (the new prefix, the references moved, the old picture deleted only when unused — kept while a page's text or another album uses it — the audit row, position and cover kept, the public album, the route at the posted quality, the refusals for a Contributor and a volunteer with nothing written and nothing expired, the undo when a reference cannot move, the text's node through the save and the sweep); unit `content/rich-text-replace-picture.test.ts` (the node's attributes, the schema, finding the node again, the editor's wiring, the one word); `public-cache/writes-expire-pages.test.ts` (`replacePhoto` expires `gallery`); e2e `gallery-replace.spec.ts` (written, not run).
changelogLine: - **«Înlocuiește» on a picture** — an album's photo is replaced in its place, keeping its order and its cover role, and a picture in a text keeps its description, caption and size with the crop cleared; one word on the team card and the bib too. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Given an album's photo, when an editorial role presses «Înlocuiește» and uploads a new file at the remembered quality, then the new picture is stored under a new key prefix and takes the same item — its order number and, if it was the cover, the cover — the public album shows it in the same place, the old picture's row and objects are deleted only when nothing else (another album, a text, a card, a bib design, a draft) uses it, one `media.picture_replaced` audit row names the old and new asset and the place, and the gallery's public cache is expired; a role that may not delete a photo is refused on the server before anything is stored (2026-10-08, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given a selected picture in a rich text, when «Înlocuiește» uploads a new file through the one upload, then the same image node takes the new address and stored size, keeps its alt, caption, width share and placement, has its crop and card centre cleared, and nothing else in the document moves; the other language's document is not touched (2026-10-08, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given a picture replaced in a text, when the editor uploads the new one, then the old picture is not deleted; once a save no longer names it, the orphan sweep deletes it after its week like any picture removed from a text, and the new one is kept (2026-10-08, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

batchLine: a picture is replaced in place («Înlocuiește») in an album and in a text
